AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WHITE, GEORGIA, PROVIDING FOR THE OPERATION OF MOTORIZED CARTS UPON CERTAIN PUBLIC STREETS; ESTABLISHING REGISTRATION AND EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS; PROVIDING FOR PENALTIES; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

PREAMBLE WHEREAS, 0.C.G.A. § 40-6-331 expressly authorizes municipalities in the State of Georgia to permit by ordinance the operation of motorized carts upon designated public streets within their jurisdiction, subject to such conditions and limitations as the governing authority may deem appropriate; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and City Council of the City of White, Georgia find that it is in the interest of the public health, safety, and general welfare to establish a clear regulatory framework governing the operation of motorized carts upon designated city streets, including minimum equipment, operator, and registration standards; and

WHEREAS, the City of White recognizes the growing demand within the community for accessible, low-speed transportation options for use on local streets, and finds that such mobility serves legitimate community interests when conducted in a safe and regulated manner; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor's stated mobility goals for the City of White include expanding transportation options for residents in a manner consistent with public safety and the character of the community, and this Ordinance is consistent with and in furtherance of those goals; and

WHEREAS, the City Council has duly reviewed and considered the terms of this Ordinance, including input from the Chief of Police and City Attorney, and finds it to be in proper legal form and consistent with applicable state law; and

WHEREAS, proper notice of the consideration of this Ordinance has been provided to the public as required by the Georgia Open Meetings Act, 0.C.G.A. § 50-14-1 et seq,, and all other applicable provisions of law;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and City Council of the City of White,
